caption:
UT Austin will pause room leasing at Dobie Twenty21 for the 2027–28 academic year.

The university announced Nov. 19 that it’s planning new housing options for the site, which will be known as Dell House. UT hasn’t announced a reopening date. Separately, a new undergraduate residence hall on Whitis Avenue is slated to open in fall 2027.

If you’re planning campus housing for 2027–28, leave Dobie off your list and check the Whitis opening timeline as you compare your options.

Source: UT Austin, Nov. 19, 2026.
